faq_heading: Sunnyside Park condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Sunnyside Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sunnyside Park, South Surrey and White Rock: 28 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 32%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 5 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Sunnyside Park fell from 43 in June to 28 in September (−34.9%), and 35 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 4.7% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 593 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Sunnyside Park?
Sunnyside Park also had 46 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 28 condos and townhomes listed. The Sunnyside Park houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Sunnyside Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

38 townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park with a median price of $962,500 (the middle half sold between $851,750 and $1,044,250), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 96.2% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $566 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $503 a month. 36 condos sold in Sunnyside Park with a median price of $506,500 (the middle half sold between $416,000 and $549,250), taking a median of 41 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $469 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $544 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 28 condos and townhomes listed in Sunnyside Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunnyside Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Sunnyside Park had a sales ratio of 32%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 35 condos and townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park over those 4 months, out of 375 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Sunnyside Park sell for?
faq.a: 38 townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $962,500.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: The median was 40 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.2% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
